tools.name: add_leg
tools.description: Add a Leg — one relocation of the Trip, flight or transfer — and return the platform result, including rejections. Send the revision from get_trip; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state. Does not book.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

revision.description: Trip revision from get_trip. Required. The platform validates the change; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state — retry from that.

origin.description: A place the Trip moves from or to.

raw.description: What the traveller said: "London", "somewhere in Scotland".

iatas.description: Resolved airport candidates, e.g. LHR, LGW.

destination.description: A place the Trip moves from or to.

raw.description: What the traveller said: "London", "somewhere in Scotland".

iatas.description: Resolved airport candidates, e.g. LHR, LGW.

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Range with date_to expresses flexibility.

tools.name: get_handoff_links
tools.description: Return LinkResolver URLs for selected offers on this Trip. Travelomi does not book; the traveller completes the booking at the source.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Return drive, walk, or transit time between two places a ground hop apart, with its computed-at time. Origin and destination are a place name or a lat,lng pair. Planning-grade, no live traffic; flight-scale pairs come back as a typed distance. No booking.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

from.description: Origin: a place name, or lat,lng.

to.description: Destination: a place name, or lat,lng.

depart.description: Transit only: desired departure as RFC3339 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-02T09:00:00+02:00.

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Return this Trip's typed compiled state, including its revision. Live offers and prices are not Trip state.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search flights for explicit origin, destination, dates and party, and return platform offers with price, currency and expiry, verbatim. Origin and destination are IATA codes (comma-separated for alternates, e.g. LHR,LGW). Display-grade prices; no booking through Travelomi.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

origin.description: Origin IATA code or comma-separated set, e.g. MLA or LHR,LGW,STN,LTN.

destination.description: Destination IATA code or comma-separated set.

return_date.description: Return date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one-way.

direct_only.description: true when they said direct or nonstop only.

tools.name: set_dates
tools.description: Set the date on a flight Leg (same path as tapping a date Card) and return the selection stream. Needs that Chat: pass the Trip's `/t/{uuid}` path, or call it on the Trip's own page. Send the revision from get_trip; a 409 returns the conflict plus fresh state. A booked Leg is refused.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

leg_id.description: Flight Leg id this date belongs to.

revision.description: Trip revision from get_trip. Required so a concurrent change is a 409, not a silent overwrite.

tools.name: set_intent
tools.description: Set the why of this Trip — the part that survives destination changes — and return the platform result. Send the revision from get_trip; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

revision.description: Trip revision from get_trip. Required. The platform validates the change; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state — retry from that.

destination.description: Current destination hypothesis, before a Leg or Stay exists.

budget.description: Whole currency units, not minor units.

tools.name: set_party
tools.description: Set who is travelling, 1–9 people, and return the platform result. Maps to set_travellers. Send the revision from get_trip; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

revision.description: Trip revision from get_trip. Required. The platform validates the change; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state — retry from that.

travellers.description: The party. Each may have a name and a from (home airport or city).

from.description: Home airport or city if they start from a different place.

tools.name: set_stay
tools.description: Add a Stay, or update one when stay.id is set, and return the platform result. Send the revision from get_trip; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state. Does not book; status booked is refused.

trip.description: Trip slug, or its /t/{uuid} Chat URL path. Defaults to the Trip on this page; required on every other page.

revision.description: Trip revision from get_trip. Required. The platform validates the change; a stale revision is a 409 with the fresh state — retry from that.

stay.description: The Stay to add (no id) or update (id set).

id.description: Existing Stay id. Omit to add a new Stay.

place.description: Where the Stay is, e.g. Kyoto.

tools.name: start_trip
tools.description: Create a Chat in this browser and return `{chat, url_path, trip}`. `url_path` is `/t/{chat.uuid}`; `trip` is null until the first turn mints it, or the existing Trip if this Chat already has one. A logged-out browser may own one Trip — a second create returns `anonymous_trip_limit` as data.

intent.description: Why this Trip exists, echoed on the result only. Destinations and dates may change; omit if unknown.
